001_div: For all · Half day to a day
003_p: Clarify who you are — then act on it, for yourself and for others.
006_p: A bucket list is usually a list of things to have. This one is a list of who you intend to be.
007_p: A session for naming what actually matters to you, and then turning it into things small enough to start this month. Co-created with Hojin Choi.
009_p: Clarity is not the same as ambition. Most people are clear about what they want and vague about who they are.
010_p: Written down and said out loud in a room of other people, an intention behaves differently — it becomes something you can be held to, gently, by people who now know about it.
013_div: Anyone, from youth upward · 10–25 in a group
015_div: Half a day, or a full day with more time to write
023_div: A first pass at the question, written before anyone discusses it.
025_div: What you want to be able to say you did — for yourself, and for someone else.
027_div: From a long list to the few items you would defend to a stranger.
029_div: One item, out loud, to the room — and a first step with a date on it.
